name: Tool description containing emoji subdivision flags
notes: Live false positive fixed by TODOS #31: an England/Scotland/Wales flag is BUILT from tag-block characters, so before the whole-sequence carve-out any server whose metadata carried one raised a tool-poisoning warning on every tools/list. The prior benign corpus contained zero codepoints in U+E0000-U+E007F and zero U+1F3F4, so a tag-block detector would have scored 0 FP against it purely because the corpus held no emoji tag sequence at all -- the gate certified nothing. This fixture and its companion are what make the zero-FP claim mean something.
